title: Download the HMRC app
text:
Watch our YouTube video to find out what you can use the HMRC app for:

 Make life easier with the HMRC app .

 Get the app

 You can download the app for iOS and Android devices.

 Sign in to the app

 Download and open the app. Enter the details you use to  sign in to HMRC online services . If you do not already have sign in details, you can create them in the app.

 You’ll then be able to sign in to the app using either:

 • 
 a 6-digit PIN

 • 
 your fingerprint

 • 
 facial recognition

 Use the app

 You can use the app to get information about your tax, National Insurance and benefits.

 Manage your information

 You can use the app to:

 • 
 update your name or your address

 • 
 choose how HMRC contacts you

 • 
 track forms and letters you have sent to us

 Manage your taxes

 You can use the app to check:

 • 
 your tax code

 • 
 your National Insurance number and save it to your Google or Apple wallet

 • 
 your Self Assessment Unique Taxpayer Reference ( UTR ) and find out how much tax you owe

 • 
 your Annual Tax Summary and employment history

 • 
 for gaps in your National Insurance record

 • 
 if you need to report additional income from a second job, investments, or a sale or transfer of an asset

 You can also use the app to:

 • 
 make payments and set reminders to make payments

 • 
 tell us if you no longer need to send a Self Assessment tax return

 • 
 estimate your take-home pay on the tax calculator

 • 
 claim a refund if you have paid too much tax

 • 
 pay gaps in your National Insurance record

 Manage your benefits

 You can use the app to:

 • 
 check your State Pension summary

 • 
 apply for and manage Child Benefit

 • 
 check your eligibility for, apply for and manage your Help to Save account

 Accessibility of the app

 Our accessibility statements describe how the app works with assistive technologies:

 • 
 Android accessibility statement 

 • 
 iOS accessibility statement 

 Data protection in the app

 For more information about how HMRC and other organisations may use your data when you use the HMRC App, read the HMRC App Privacy Notice .
